scientific_integrity: The all-lag proof is analytical; exact rational finite checks are supplementary. The work has not been independently audited or externally certified.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the stationary, annealed random doubling/halving map for 1/2<p<=1 and two-time polynomial coordinate moments. It neither proves full path reversibility nor covers the null-recurrent boundary, and the priority of possible equivalent higher-moment calculations outside inspected literature is uncertain.
title: A hidden quartic time arrow in the stationary Pelikan random map
